    Nutraceutical Ingredients

    Green Coffee

    Coffea arabica / robusta

    Chlorogenic-acid-rich unroasted bean extract, with caffeinated and decaffeinated grades available.

    Part used
    Unroasted bean
    Marker compound
    Chlorogenic Acid
    Available forms
    Coffee Oil, Extract
    Typical grade
    Typical range 45–50% total CGA
    Request a Quote Request Technical Data Sheet

    Also on request: Safety Data Sheet · COA · Product brochure

    Overview

    Green coffee extract is drawn from unroasted beans, which retain far higher chlorogenic acid (CGA) levels than roasted beans, since roasting degrades most of it. CGA is the defining active; natural caffeine is also present unless a decaffeinated grade is specified.

    Applications

    • Weight management supplements: the dominant use case for standardized CGA extract.
    • Cosmetics: green coffee oil (the bean's lipid fraction) in eye-care and firming skincare.
